headline: Business Standard publishes a fund review of Bandhan Short Term Fund
hook: Assessing a popular debt fund option
summary: Business Standard has released a fund review of Bandhan Short Term Fund. The review provides an analysis of the short-term debt fund's performance and portfolio. Investors in mutual funds and fixed-income products look to such reviews to gauge debt fund yields. Retail investors with exposure to debt mutual funds should evaluate fund duration risks and credit quality.
why_it_matters: Evaluates short-term debt fund performance for retail investors.
